title: Execute audited Range component polish
description: Complete Range implementation from the audit after modularization, covering input containment, vertical layout, handle variants, track variants, labels, ticks, and generic numeric-field semantics.
objective: Make Range a polished numeric filter that is not price-biased and does not overflow.
expected_outputs: Mechanical implementation commit b5acb82 adds configurable vertical sides for current value labels and scale ticks
Range submodules remain split for inputs, track, handle, value labels, ticks, and vertical layout
Generic numeric-field labels and defaults remain in place through Show Number Inputs and side/placement controls
Containment-safe horizontal and vertical variants are mechanically guarded; visual acceptance remains Guilherme-owned
acceptance_criteria: Range labels respect their on/off switch.
Vertical mode supports alignment without forced centering.
Inputs and handles stay inside assigned layout width.
Guilherme visual QA is required for range variants.
verification: php -l passes for RangeLayoutStyleControls.php, RangeRenderer.php, and scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php.
./scripts/wp.sh eval-file wp-content/plugins/elementor-implementation-toolkit/scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php passes with 51 passed, 0 failed, and 6 Guilherme-owned visual QA skips.
WP-CLI RangeRenderer characterization passes for vertical value-label and scale-tick side classes.
Plugin commit b5acb82 pushed to origin/main.
TEST-FC-ROBUSTNESS-006 remains human-QA-gated for visual craft.
